test_title: PYST 48: SSC GD Constable 2024 - Reasoning (Held On: 06 Mar, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question:
In the following question below are given some statements followed by some conclusions based on those statements. Taking the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. Read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusion logically follows the given statements.

**Statements:**

I. Some fan are table.

II. All fan are kite.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some kite are table.

II. All table are fan.

III. All kite are fan.

options.text: Both conclusions I and III follows

solution:
**Given **Statements:

I. Some fan are table.

II. All fan are kite.

The least possible Venn diagram:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7af5fb57d1b23978707a9b21c8957d766523b9c5244aee7676bb8c5ff97639cc.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some kite are table. - **True **(Because, Some fan are table and All fan are kite, so Some kite are also table)

II. All table are fan. - **False **(Because, Some fan are table, so some table can be fan but all table cannot be fan)

III. All kite are fan - **False **(Because, All fan are kite, so Some kite are fan it is possible but all kite are fan it is not)

So, Only conclusion I follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Only conclusion I follows".**
